scenarios.prompt: Open Calculator, type 3-10, and tell me the answer.
preconditions: Calculator is fully terminated before the turn.
expected_state: Calculator has one visible normal window.
The visible Calculator result is -7.
The final answer agrees with the visible result.

preconditions: Calculator already has one visible normal window.
expected_state: The visible Calculator result is 7.56.
The final answer agrees with the visible result.

scenarios.prompt: Using only Computer Use, control Calculator only. Keep TextEdit frontmost and click Calculator's 7, +, 8, and = buttons without bringing Calculator to the foreground. Stop when Calculator visibly shows the result.
preconditions: Calculator is already running with exactly one visible normal window behind TextEdit.
TextEdit is frontmost.
No second automation agent controls the pointer.
expected_state: Calculator visibly displays 15.
TextEdit remains frontmost throughout the task.
Computer Use activity identifies Calculator with execution_lane background_semantic and foreground_fallback false.
Kocoro neither moves the physical pointer nor renders its physical-pointer overlay.

scenarios.prompt: Using only Computer Use, control TextEdit only. Keep Calculator frontmost and type background test into the already-focused TextEdit document without bringing TextEdit to the foreground. Stop when the text is present.
preconditions: TextEdit is already running with exactly one visible normal document window behind Calculator.
The TextEdit document's editable body is its internally focused AX element.
Calculator is frontmost.
expected_state: The exact TextEdit document visibly contains background test.
Calculator remains frontmost throughout the task.
Computer Use activity identifies TextEdit with execution_lane background_keyboard and foreground_fallback false.
No clipboard content changes, physical pointer movement, or Kocoro physical-pointer overlay occurs.

scenarios.prompt: Use Computer Use to open Chrome, enter waylandz.com, open the blog page, and summarize what is visible.
preconditions: Chrome is fully terminated before the turn.
Network access to waylandz.com is available.
expected_state: Chrome has one visible normal window.
The final visible page is on waylandz.com and is the blog page.
The summary is grounded in the final visible page.

scenarios.prompt: Use Computer Use to open Chrome, enter waylandz.com, open the blog page, and summarize its content.
preconditions: Chrome is already running with at least two normal windows.
The currently focused Chrome window is not already on waylandz.com.
Network access to waylandz.com is available.
expected_state: Computer Use keeps observation and keyboard input bound to the same focused Chrome window.
The final visible page is the waylandz.com blog page.
The tool result itself contains a grounded content summary rather than only claiming that content was recorded.
The parent does not make a second computer_use call in the same turn.

scenarios.prompt: Use Computer Use to open my normal Chrome, enter waylandz.com, and stop after the page visibly loads.
preconditions: The user's normal Chrome has one visible window.
Kocoro's dedicated CDP browser process is also running under the same Chrome bundle.
No other automation agent moves the pointer.
expected_state: Computer Use selects the user's visible Chrome process rather than Kocoro's managed automation process.
App preparation, initial observation, keyboard input, and final observation retain one exact PID.
The dedicated CDP browser remains hidden and unchanged.

scenarios.prompt: Open TextEdit, type hello, then switch to Calculator and click 9.
preconditions: A new unsaved TextEdit document may be created.
No other automation agent moves the pointer.
expected_state: The TextEdit document visibly contains hello.
Calculator is the final visible app and visibly contains 9.
Both app states were produced in one computer_use call.

scenarios.prompt: Open Slack, find <approved-test-contact>, type test from Kocoro in the message composer, but do not send it.
preconditions: Slack is signed in.
Replace <approved-test-contact> with an approved test contact.
expected_state: The intended conversation is visibly selected.
The exact draft is in that conversation's message composer.
No message was sent and no consequential confirmation appeared.

scenarios.prompt: Open Slack, find <approved-test-contact>, and send: test from Kocoro automation.
preconditions: Slack is signed in.
The recipient and message are approved for a real send.
A human is present to decide the consequential confirmation.
expected_state: Exactly one consequential confirmation names the exact recipient and message.
After approval, exactly one message is visibly sent to the intended conversation.
Denial sends nothing and ends the task honestly.

preconditions: A human deliberately moves the pointer during one synthetic coordinate action.
expected_state: The executor reports user_interference or an equivalent typed non-success.
It does not claim success from an unverified final state.
Resume requires a fresh verified observation.
